purpose: Fail-closed authorization contract between Control Plane policy and every Execution/Connection adapter that can cause a side effect.

permission_classes.P0_READ_PUBLIC_OR_CANONICAL: routine permitted reads within declared data exposure scope
permission_classes.P4_OWNER_GATE_REQUIRED: protected data, gated spend, constitutional or major irreversible/external commitment operations
permission_classes.P5_PROHIBITED: forbidden regardless of autonomy or grant

execution_must_reject_when: policy_generation or policy_digest does not match the currently accepted policy identity
grant is missing where required, expired, superseded or revoked
revocation generation is stale relative to current revocation state
safe mode generation is stale relative to current safe-mode state
requested permission class exceeds permission ceiling
operation or target is outside authorized scope
P4 operation lacks the exact valid Owner Gate reference
adapter attempts to downgrade the operation's permission classification to fit a grant
any required fact is UNKNOWN, contradictory or cannot be verified

allowed_classes_by_default: reversible containment explicitly authorized by safe-mode policy

autonomy_rule: L0-L5 changes orchestration freedom only inside the permission envelope; autonomy never widens permission ceiling or overrides deny precedence.
adapter_rule: Every side-effecting provider/tool adapter MUST enforce this contract or be classified nonconforming and unavailable for governed execution.
failure_rule: Missing/stale/out-of-scope/revoked/unknown authorization state MUST reject rather than guess or continue.
